name: Easepick
description: Attaches the easepick JavaScript date/range picker to Drupal forms via a form flag and hook_form_alter.
library_dependencies: @easepick/amp-plugin / kbd-plugin / lock-plugin / range-plugin / preset-plugin / time-plugin 1.2.1 (loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net)
project_description: Easepick is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript date picker. This Drupal module wraps the easepick library so it can be attached to Drupal forms. It ships Drupal asset libraries for the easepick bundle, core, datetime, and each easepick plugin (amp, kbd, lock, range, preset, time), all sourced from the jsDelivr CDN, plus a small initializer (assets/js/easepick.js) and a demo route (/easepick/example). Integration is code-driven: an implementing developer adds a value element $form['easepick']['#value'] = TRUE to a form, and easepick_form_alter() attaches the easepick.core and drupal.easepick libraries. The bundled initializer instantiates easepick against the field whose HTML id is edit-checkin. The module has no admin UI, no configuration, no permissions, no services and no config schema.
